newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco board considers $233 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco board considers $233 mln of bonds.

text.p: San Francisco's Board of Supervisors is expected on Tuesday to consider three proposed bond issues for a total of $233 million to finance school, community center and zoo improvements.
The proposals include a $140 million bond for schools and community college campuses, a $45 million bond to cover multicultural community centers and a $48 million bond for the San Francisco zoo.
Supporters of the bond measures hope to place them on a special June 3 ballot. The bonds would then require two-thirds support of voters to pass.
